Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to get additional DP but then choose to not have that Digimon attack?

Effect: When this card would be played, if there are 3 or more Digimon, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of your Digimon may get +5000 DP for the turn and attack your opponent's Digimon.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
[Your Turn] All of your [Iliad] trait Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ and ＜Piercing＞.
